guardian:
Use case: illustration-story, identity-preserving scene expansion.
Create one finished 16:9 landscape narrative game ending painting by expanding the supplied ORIGINAL game character references into a complete new scene. Reference image 1 is the adult heroine Nura, reference image 2 is the same adult heroine's face and hand-drawn paper-texture finish. Preserve her distinctive face, warm medium brown skin, short dark hair, dark green plain headscarf, long grey olive coat over loose taupe trousers and practical brown shoes. She is an ADULT woman about 25 years old, never a child soldier.
Scene: an original explicitly fantastical adult future in a central Asian mountain pass. A stone-walled refuge overlooks jagged, steep mountains. In the near midground LEFT OF CENTER, Nura leans forward with one arm extended, palm down, giving a clear protective hold-the-line signal. Three to five ADULT women guards wearing modest muted dark green headscarves, long practical coats, loose trousers and simple leather protective pieces are actively moving sideways into a staggered defensive line across the mountain gate. Natural anatomy, distinct faces, visible coordinated actions, no lineup portraits. Nura is visibly the leader among equals, not standing in front of a blank backdrop.
On the RIGHT and BEHIND the protective line, several young girls carrying simple school satchels walk along a sheltered pathway toward a small open school doorway. All guards are adult women; all children are unarmed and protected. Any hostile men must be tiny distant silhouettes outside the boundary, not foreground characters. No violence or firing. No modern tactical uniforms, no sexualized clothes.
Visual language: delicately hand-inked 2D animation illustration with soft painted paper grain, simplified natural forms, restrained shading, cinematic storytelling composition. Cool emerald morning light, misty blue-green stone and pale sky. Strong diagonal vertical mountain-wall composition, foreground masonry at bottom. Full or three-quarter natural human figures integrated into the environment, eyes expressive, hands clear.
Composition: wide cinematic 16:9; decisive heroine gesture, all heads, guards' movement and protected schoolchildren in the UPPER and MIDDLE 70% of the picture. Bottom 25% mostly quiet foreground rock/path because the game overlays a translucent UI. No captions, no visible writing, no title, no symbols, no border, no watermark. Render a complete illustration with an opaque background; do not output a cutout, sprite sheet, geometric vector picture, poster, or collage.
commons:
Use case: illustration-story, identity-preserving scene expansion.
Create one finished 16:9 landscape narrative game ending painting by expanding the supplied original character references into a complete new place and action. Reference image 1 is ADULT heroine Nura: preserve her distinctive face, short dark hair, warm medium brown skin, plain dark green headscarf, long grey olive outer coat over loose taupe trousers. Reference image 2 is her older sister Marian as a teenager: portray the SAME woman now adult, with her longer face and thick dark braid tucked under a plain muted brown headscarf, a dark brick-red long tunic and loose trousers. Reference image 3 is her friend Layla disguised as a boy in childhood: now portray her as an ADULT woman with the same distinct broad eyebrows and eyes, plain burnt-ochre headscarf and long practical grey-brown clothing. ALL lead women are clearly at least 25 years old.
Scene: an original wished-for adult future in a central Asian mountain city. A generous sunlit PUBLIC COURTYARD, sheltered by warm mud-brick buildings, with a working SCHOOL doorway on the LEFT and women-run small MARKET STALLS on the RIGHT. In the CENTRAL foreground/midground, a round circle of several adult women holding a shared civic meeting. One woman is standing with her hand raised to speak. Nura stands slightly to the RIGHT of the central seat, physically pulling the simple chair out and extending her open palm toward that speaking woman, visibly yielding the place and listening rather than commanding. Warm natural eye contact and thoughtful faces. Her movement makes the public decision belong to the others.
At the LEFT, Marian pushes a wooden classroom door fully open and gently ushers several unarmed schoolgirls carrying simple notebooks inside. At the RIGHT REAR, Layla lifts a shop shutter and arranges baskets and cloth at her own small stall; another woman buyer reaches for goods. These are real activities with expressive hands and poses, not statues or posed portraits. Many distinct, modestly dressed adult women and girls, all with naturally proportioned anatomy. No men, soldiers, shields, weapons, military line, watchtower or fortress. NO writing visible anywhere, no lettering on books or signs; blank book covers.
Visual language: softly hand-inked 2D animation storybook painting, delicate paper texture, coherent light and shadow, natural face and limb anatomy. Warm golden morning, light terracotta, cream, muted sage, modest dusty brown and ochre scarves, no neon multicolored costumes. A calm semicircular courtyard composition markedly different from a narrow mountain defense scene.
Composition: wide cinematic 16:9; the heroine's open gesture, standing speaker, school doorway, market actions and all key faces sit in the UPPER/MIDDLE 70% of the image. Bottom 25% mostly sunlit quiet courtyard paving with a few low cushions because a translucent game UI will overlay that area. Full or three-quarter figures integrated into one environment. No title, no caption, no border, no watermark, no split panels, no collage, no sprite cutouts, no geometric vector style. Opaque complete scene.
